fields.description: Perla Prime, documented as Perla 1, is a Yas Bay waterfront development of duplex apartments and triplex townhouses. Its two-, three- and five-bedroom apartments differ from the four-bedroom townhouse layout.

sources.label: Perla 1 / Prime · original brochure and home drawings
Perla 1 · public floor plans linked by original brochure

research.locationNote: Yas Bay waterfront, Yas Island, Abu Dhabi. Prime is distinct from Perla Waves and Perla Heights.
overview: The original programme lists 83 two-bedroom duplexes, 97 three-bedroom duplexes, nine four-bedroom townhouses and one five-bedroom duplex.
research.priceNote: Bayut records an AED 1.5 million launch reference. Current developer prices and available units were not verified.
research.paymentNote: Bayut lists 10% down and 90% before handover. This is a secondary reference; confirm the dated offer for the selected unit.
research.handoverNote: The original fact sheet targeted Q3 2025, which has elapsed. The developer’s undated 31.6% progress snapshot does not establish current completion; obtain a revised contractual date.

facts.value: Published whole-home totals include outdoor areas; plots are separate.

facts.value: 206 covered spaces; confirm the selected home’s allocation.
